market_name: Will 9 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the move in the market is idiosyncratic (thin book) or corroborated by Fed funds futures/SOFR curve steepening dovishly.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT and 2y/10y yield reaction to any macro news (jobless claims, CPI leak, geopolitical shock) that could justify emergency easing.
time_plan.2h: Confirm whether short-rate futures (SOFR, Fed funds) are pricing added cuts; divergence means the Polymarket move is noise.
time_plan.6h: Reassess if TLT gains held; check for Fed speaker headlines or risk-off flows.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether dovish repricing persisted into the next session; mark thesis outcome.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 9 Fed cuts in 2026 (225bps of easing) would signal a dramatic dovish repricing — consistent with recession fears or an emergency-cut environment. That pushes front-end and long-end yields lower, lifting long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a big dovish shift.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and whether the dovish signal is US-specific vs global.
time_plan.1h: Look at rate-differential-sensitive pairs (EURUSD, USDJPY) for confirmation.
time_plan.2h: Distinguish 'dovish Fed' dollar weakness from 'risk-off' dollar strength — the latter would invalidate this.
time_plan.6h: Reassess dollar direction against equity/vol backdrop.
time_plan.12h: Mark whether dollar weakened on the dovish repricing or safe-haven flows dominated.

predictions.reasoning: An aggressive expected Fed easing path (9 cuts) narrows US rate differentials and typically weakens the dollar. UUP is a liquid dollar proxy. Effect is weaker and noisier than the rate channel because global risk-off can paradoxically bid the dollar.

evidence_used: Market question implies 9 cuts = ~225bps of 2026 easing, an extreme dovish/emergency-easing tail scenario
Rate-cut expectations map directly to Treasury yields, the dollar, and gold via standard monetary-transmission channels
Market allows emergency inter-meeting cuts, tying the tail to crisis/recession scenarios
uncertainty_notes: A 700bps 12h move threshold is far above realistic single-session moves in TLT/UUP; neither prediction is 'tradable' at that bar
Polymarket rate-cut markets can be thin and mispriced; a probability jump may be noise not information
Direction of equities and dollar is ambiguous — recession fears (risk-off) vs. easing tailwind pull opposite ways

llm_justification.summary: The market prices an extreme tail (9 Fed cuts in 2026). A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal a dramatically dovish or emergency-easing/recession scenario, which most cleanly lifts long-duration Treasuries (TLT up) and, more weakly and ambiguously, pressures the dollar (UUP down). Magnitudes in a 12h window are modest — well below the 700bps tradable threshold — so this is a low-confidence, research-only mapping.
key_assumptions: A probability move reflects genuine dovish repricing rather than thin-market noise
Standard rate-transmission channels hold: more expected cuts → lower yields, weaker USD
The signal is US-specific, not a global risk event that flips dollar direction
failure_modes: Move reverses quickly as an illiquid-market artifact
The dovish shift is driven by a recession/risk-off shock that bids the dollar and hits Treasuries via credit/liquidity, inverting the dollar call
Information already public (post-FOMC, CPI print) so proxies already repriced
9-cut strike is a deep tail; small absolute probability changes carry little real macro signal
12h magnitude far below the 700bps tradable bar, so no actionable edge
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
